content.title: Single-Prop Skill Ladder | Base Loop, Aerial Upgrade, Hero Return
content.summary: A rescue trainer escalates a pole orbit through vault, water contact and toss-catch. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One adult performer and one prop remain identity anchors. + A repeatable base loop is proven before escalation. + Each new skill adds one difficulty dimension only. + Environmental effects occur only at visible contact. + The prop returns to the opening guard state.
quick_start.recommended_input: Place one adult night rescue trainer on a wet depot roof with one orange telescoping pole. Add one low vault over a marked vent while the same pole remains fully visible. Complete one short toss and catch, then return the pole to the opening guard stance beside the same vent.
required_anchors: One adult performer and one prop remain identity anchors.
A repeatable base loop is proven before escalation.
Environmental effects occur only at visible contact.
The prop returns to the opening guard state.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: A rescue trainer escalates a pole orbit through vault, water contact and toss-catch. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
